category: Usenet binary search engine (HTML search, anonymous)

free_tier.stated: Reported as no registration required. The site offers search by filename, subject or author, a newsgroup browser and an RSS feed, and 'integrated Usenet downloading services to provide direct NZB download'. No daily counter is published.
free_tier.notes: A direct request answered HTTP 522 from the edge.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file, never the payload

retention.stated: The search form offers an age filter up to 750 days; a third-party listing claims 'Up to 750 days, 2,000 newsgroups accessible'.
retention.notes: documented as the longest age filter offered, not measured

egress.terms: No byte metering; the answer is an NZB pointer file.

interface_detail: HTML search form with an RSS feed advertised by the page; no Newznab API was found on the pages read.
tooling: No Newznab API is described, so Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 cannot add it; a wrapper would parse the search page. That is a tooling note, not a verdict.
chaining: A fallback search for a name that the API indexers lack; the origin timing out makes it unreliable as a first choice.

limits.value: none published: no counter on the pages read

limits_note: No request counter or byte counter is published. The origin timing out (HTTP 522 on the read date) is an availability problem that no vocabulary kind names; see reliability_note.
binding_note: No numeric limit is named on any page read; availability of the origin is what fails first and it is recorded in reliability_note.

identity_cost.detail: Reported 'No registration required'; the search form and the page text show no login field. A download was not run.

reliability_note: A third-party listing says 'Almost always having downtime issues'; a direct request on the read date got HTTP 522 from the edge.
confidence_note: The no-registration claim and the downtime claim are third-party; the page text is first-party and the 522 is a probe. No search or NZB download was completed.

evidence.quote: FindNZB integrated Usenet downloading services to provide direct NZB download.
evidence.proved: the site says it offers direct NZB download through integrated downloading services

evidence.quote: | Age of posts: | -- show all -- 24 hours 1 week 2 week 3 week 50 days 70 days 100 days 120 days 365 days 600 days 750 days |
evidence.proved: the longest age filter on the search form is 750 days
third-party: the site is almost always having downtime issues
a direct request answered HTTP 522 from the edge, so the origin timed out
